forms.serverErrors.VAT_PERIOD_FILED: The VAT return for this period has been filed, so the period is closed. Date the document in the current open period: a net tax difference of up to AED 10,000 is corrected in that return (Executive Regulation Art. 70). Above AED 10,000, make a voluntary disclosure (amend the filed return) first.

forms.serverErrors.CONTROL_ACCOUNT_NOT_A: A control account (receivables, payables, inventory, VAT, goods received not invoiced or payroll payables) cannot be chosen here: its own module posts it. Pick an expense, asset, bank or other account; stock goes through a product and VAT through the VAT rate.
forms.controlAccountsHidden: Control accounts (receivables, payables, inventory, VAT, payroll) are not listed: their own modules post them.
forms.serverErrors.CONTROL_ADJUSTMENT_RO: Only an owner, admin, accountant or CFO can adjust a control account directly.

forms.serverErrors.controlPath.receivabl: Match the bank line or receipt to the customer's invoice, or record a customer deposit.
forms.serverErrors.controlPath.payables: Match the bank line or payment to the supplier's bill.
forms.serverErrors.controlPath.inventory: Record a stock movement, adjustment or stocktake in Inventory.
forms.serverErrors.controlPath.vat: Pay or receive a filed VAT return through its settlement in VAT filing.
forms.serverErrors.controlPath.grni: Receive the goods against the purchase order, then bill them.
forms.serverErrors.controlPath.payroll: Use the payroll run payment, the pension payment or the final settlement.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY: This journal entry was posted by a document and is undone from that document, so the document and the general ledger stay in step.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.invoi: This journal entry was posted by an invoice. Void the invoice or issue a credit note, so the invoice and the general ledger stay in step.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.custo: This journal entry was posted by a customer payment. Reverse the payment or credit from the invoice.
This journal entry was posted by a customer deposit. Refund or reverse the deposit.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.bill: This journal entry was posted by a bill. Void the bill or raise a debit note, so the bill and the general ledger stay in step.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.bill_: This journal entry was posted by a bill payment. Void the bill payment.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.inven: This journal entry was posted by a stock movement. Record a reversing stock movement or adjustment.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.payro: This journal entry was posted by payroll. Reverse the payroll run, payment or settlement.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.vat_r: This journal entry was posted by a VAT return. Use the return's settlement, relief or amendment flow.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.fixed: This journal entry was posted by the fixed-asset register. Correct it in the register.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.fx_re: This journal entry was posted by an FX revaluation. Undo the revaluation run.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.bank_: This journal entry was posted from a bank statement line. Unmatch the line in Bank reconciliation.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.recei: This journal entry was posted by a receipt. Revise the receipt.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.expen: This journal entry was posted by an expense claim. Reverse the expense claim.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.impor: This journal entry holds imported opening balances. Correct them with a reasoned adjustment.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.corpo: This journal entry was posted by the corporate tax return. Use the return's provision flow.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.fisca: This journal entry closes a fiscal year. Re-open the fiscal year instead.
forms.serverErrors.SUBLEDGER_ENTRY.vat_w: This journal entry was posted from the VAT workpaper. Correct the row there.
forms.serverErrors.INVOICE_BILLS_ASSET_D: This invoice bills a fixed-asset disposal. Issue a credit note for a price change; the disposal itself stays in the fixed-asset register.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_AMENDMENT_NOTHING: The amended return changes nothing that was already paid or refunded, so there is nothing to settle.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_SETTLEMENT_COUNTE: A later amended return's settlement already counted this payment. Reverse the latest amendment's settlement first, then this one.
forms.errors.uaeTrnPrefix100: A UAE TRN is 15 digits and starts with 100. Check your FTA registration certificate.
forms.budget.accountHelp: Actuals for this line come from this income or expense account in your books.
forms.budget.noAccount: No account linked: actuals cannot be read. Edit the line and choose an account.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_FILED_ON_FUTURE: The filing date cannot be in the future.

forms.serverErrors.VAT_SETTLEMENT_DATE_I: The VAT payment or refund is dated after the end of the return period.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_RETURN_ALREADY_SE: A payment is already recorded for this return. Reverse it first to record a different one.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_RETURN_NOT_SUBMIT: Record the EmaraTax filing before recording the payment or refund.
forms.serverErrors.VAT_RETURN_NOTHING_TO: This return has nothing to pay or receive.
forms.errors.depreciationMonthNotEnded: This month has not ended yet. Choose a month that has ended.

forms.serverErrors.DISPOSAL_BEFORE_DEPRE: Depreciation is already recorded after this disposal date. Dispose of the asset on or after the last depreciation date.
